newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ sells catering unit to SCIS.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ sells catering unit to SCIS.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to sell its catering unit to the world's largest in-flight caterer, SC International Services Inc (SCIS).
SCIS operates its international in-flight business through two major wholly-owned subsidiaries, Sky Chefs Inc and Caterair International Inc.
Dallas-based company LSG/Sky Chefs Inc is an affiliate of German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG.
The catering business bought from Air New Zealand will be operated by a new company, Caterair New Zealand Ltd.
The transaction is expected to be completed in 12 weeks, the statement added.
